title: Chicken Coop Auto-Door Audit
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chickencoop:door
| stats latest(state) as state, latest(_time) as last_action, latest(sunset_epoch) as sunset
| eval closed_after_dark=if(state="closed" AND last_action>sunset,1,0), risk=if(state="open" AND now()>sunset+1800,1,0)
description: Confirms the automatic coop door actually closed after dusk, the difference between safe hens and a fox's easy dinner.
value: A coop door that fails to close is discovered only after a predator gets in; a nightly confirmation prevents heartbreak.
implementation: Ingest coop-door events into `index=personal`; alert if the door is still open well after sunset.
visualization: Status panel of door state with a post-sunset risk flag.
grandmaExplanation: It checks the automatic chicken-coop door really closed at dusk, keeping the hens safe from foxes.
